[SWS_DM_01561] Response Body for SOVD fault environment_data table
⌈
SOVD attribute / JSON object
parameter key
SOVD
Datatype
Deviation Rule
environment_data
object
Available if snapshot record data or
extended data is supported for the DTC.
environment_data /
extended_data_records
object
Available if at least one
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecord is
configured for the DTC.
▽ △
environment_data /
extended_data_records /
<extended data record
content>
object
<extended data record content> is a list of
all DiagnosticExtendedDataRecords
that are referred via
DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.
extendedDataRecord. For each
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecords the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecord.
shortName shall be used for the name and
the captured value read in
[SWS_DM_00895] and [SWS_DM_00949].
The content shall be represented analog to
the content of the SOVD method Read
single data value from an Entity.
environment_data /
snapshots
array
Available if snapshot record data is
configured for the DTC.
environment_data /
snapshots / {Array Element}
object
Each freeze frame shall be represented
by one element in the array.
environment_data /
snapshots / {Array Element} /
name
string
In case
DiagnosticMemoryDestination.
typeOfFreezeFrameRecordNumera-
tion is set to configured the attribute
name shall be derived from the shortName
of the corresponding
DiagnosticFreezeFrame.
In case
DiagnosticMemoryDestination.
typeOfFreezeFrameRecordNumera-
tion is set to calculated the attribute
name shall be calculated following the
pattern "occurrence_{occ}", where "{occ}"
represents the record numeration.
The first occurrence shall always use the fix
string "first_occurrence".
The last occurrence shall always use the fix
string "last_occurrence".
▽ △
environment_data /
snapshots / {Array Element} /
data / {
DiagnosticDataElement.
shortName} + {Diagnos-
ticSovdContentElement.
shortName}
Snapshot data consists of captured
snapshot data from the UDS and SOVD
modelling and both data sources are
combined here.
For UDS the key
DiagnosticDataElement.shortName
shall be derived from the shortName of the
corresponding DiagnosticDataElement.
The object shall contain the Diagnostic
Snapshot Record of the corresponding
fault.
For SOVD the key
DiagnosticSovdContentElement.
shortName shall be derived from the
shortName of the corresponding
DiagnosticSovdContentElement. The
object shall contain the Diagnostic
Snapshot Record of the corresponding
fault.
The UDS and SOVD based data content
shall be represented analog to the content
of the SOVD method Read Single Data
Value from an Entity.
⌋
